0.title: Scripted Setup
0.body:
The randomiser cards actually serve a purpose here, and you can use them to setup your games.

Setting Up Mages:
Either:
* Pull a mage bag onto a player board.
or
* Place a single Mage Randomiser card onto a player board.

Setting Up The Market:
Either:
* Pull any given Market Mini-Deck onto a market space.
* Place a single Market Randomiser Card onto a market space.
* Setup the market randomly using the scripted board. You can either force it to use a random market randomiser, or select a specific one for you to use.
* Use the Randomizer Customisation board to change what cards are possible. It's possible to setup the randomizer decks so certain market cards don't work - you'll be notified what's missing and can easily fix it yourself by doing the above.

Setting Up The Nemesis:
Do NOT:
Pull decks from the Basic Nemesis Bags and split them apart. These are in the correct locations and quantities and removing/editing them could break scripting.

Do the following.
1) Select how many players are playing, as well as the current expedition level. If you are not playing Expedition Mode, your Expedition Level is 1.

2) Select where you wish to use the original Turn Order cards, or the ones added in later editions.
If you are playing with two or fewer Mages, then you do not need to bother.

3) Select which Basic Nemesis deck you wish to use, off the board. You can also use all of them, Balanced setups a new Basic Nemesis akin to the normal Basic Nemesis decks. 

4) Select what Upgraded Basics Nemesis cards you wish to use. If you are not playing Expedition or Expedition Level is 1, you don't need to do this.

5) Once the above is done, select your Nemesis from the Nemesis Randomiser decks, or using a Nemesis bag, and pull that single card or bag onto the Nemesis Scripting Board.

Scripting will take about 20-30 seconds. Some of the delay has been added only due to TTS loading causing issues.

Note, that certain Nemesis setups require player agency or are really not feasible to script. Reminder cards will spawn if you still need to do something.

Additional Notes:
When setting up the All Games Basic Nemesis deck, you can select specifically which ratio of card types you wish to use (Aeon's End/War Eternal, Legacy and New Age/Outcasts). All Games (Chaos) sets up the Basic Nemesis without regard to card type ratios.

All Upgraded Basics does not bother setting up the Upgraded Deck with correct card ratios, but you should not get duplicates.

Due to the nature of Legacy of Gravehold basic cards, I've considered not including them in the "all" selection, let me know what y'all think if its worth it or not.

13.title: Expedition
13.body:
Since the game needs to completely reset between Expedition games, this is how you maintain information between games:

* Place any relevant Randomiser cards to the Barracks chest. These cards will be placed there automatically when selecting Nemesis, Mages, and the Market.

* Play any relevant unlocked treasure cards to the Barracks chest. Given the level of agency sometimes required, this is NOT done automatically.

* The Game Moderator should save the chest when you're done with a game.



Then reload the mod, and the Game Moderator should pull that chest into the new load.

Any and all randomiser cards in the chest can be used to quickly setup market, and mages as needed.

The Nemesis Card can be used if you need to fight a rematch.

14.title: Modified/Homebrew Cards
14.body:
[b][u]Glyph Enigma:[/b][/u]
One of the promo cards was Glyph Enigma, a crystal Golem monster. 
A later promo release printed a different card... with the same art and very slightly different name. I'm not sure if this is meant to replace Glyph or not, but they're very functionally different. Both were included here, but the 'reprint' had its art and name replaced by the otherwise unused Legacy only card, Merciless Titan. It's card text is the same as the Glyph reprint.


[b][u]Aeon's End: Legacy Final Evolutions:[/b][/u]
Due to expedition mode originally lacking a bit of variety in Upgraded Basic Nemesis cards, I updated the Aeon's End Legacy Final Evolutions cards to match the card designs of the Upgraded Basics. 
They seem about the same power level, other than what's noted below.
Many Legacy Evolutions got used wholesale in later Upgraded Basic decks.

These can be told apart from the printed Upgraded by the "Legacy" text in the lower left corner, if you wish to remove them. Their card text and health are unmodified, aside from what's noted below.

[b][u]Humming Drones:[/b][/u]
Humming Drones are a Final Evolution card in Legacy that normally targets a single named Mage. Legacy postgame rules say  if you use this outside of Legacy, to treat this instead as "Any player", so I photoshopped the name of the usermade Mage out and put in the "Any player" text, to help lessen confusion.

[b][u]Additional Homebrew Boards/Cards:[/b][/u]
Certain Mages/Nemesis have additional custom boards that don't exist in the basic game.
These are mostly to serve as rules reminder or to help play the game in Tabletop Simulator.

This includes: Both Gygar versions, Bishop of Scrolls, Maiden of Thorns, Griefweaver.

Some Nemesis have new Reminder cards that don't exist outside of this mod either, simply because these involve setups that involve player choice to some degree. These include Prince of Gluttons, Ageless Walker, Thief of Dreams, Maiden of Thorns, Gate Witch.

[u][b]Legacy of Gravehold:[/b][/u]
A lot of Legacy of Gravehold cards, whilst playable outside of the Campaign, normally feature rules text that only applies to playing the Legacy of Gravehold story. To help prevent confusion, these cards have been edited and rules text go unused outside of Legacy of Gravehold has been removed.

The original card images have been put on the Image sheets imported into Tabletop Simulator in case you want to look for yourselves.

You can tell apart any edited Legacy of Gravehold cards by the "LoG" watermark on the lower left of the cards.

[b][u]Bishop of Scrolls:[/b][/u]
The original board for Bishop of Scrolls also contains a lot of rules text that goes unused outside of playing LoG's story. This board again has been modified.
The original board has been imported and is dumped into 'Destroyed Objects' if you wish to read it.

[b][u]Legacy of Gravehold Upgraded Basics:[/b][/u]
These are also edited like the Legacy of Gravehold basics. I've also given them the Upgraded Basics border seen in New Age & Outcasts. I'm not sure why the original cards lack this, seems like an oversight to me. Again, any text that goes unused outside of LoG's story is removed, and again, the original card images have been put on the Image sheets. They seem weaker on average than the Final Evolution Minions, so I doubt they'll be a probably going forward.

[b][u]Incompatible Legacy of Gravehold Cards:[/b][/u]
These have also been scanned and can be found on the image sheets. This includes the cards for the Final Batle Nemesis - a Nemesis that is unusable outside of LoG's story.

[b][u]Nerfed Cards:[/b][/u]
After a whole lot of play, me and my friends came to the conclusion that the following Legacy cards are more powerful than the usual Upgraded Basics, and have nerfed them accordingly:
* Spine Reaper - Reduced from 2 health to 1.
* Skybound Leviathan - Reduced from 9 health to 7.
* Maddening Eidolon - Reduced from 4 shields to 3.

The 'original' versions can be found in the bags containing the basics. Don't really recommend using them, but if you wish...

15.title: Legacy of Gravehold
15.body:
Since the Nemeses "Z'hana" and "Brama" are completely incompatible without balance changes outside of the Legacy scenario, I have not ported these to the mod.
[i](Their cards HAVE been scanned though. You can find those on the card sheets.)[/i]

The other compatible cards, Nemeses, market cards, etc, are included, as are the rules for the Mechanics introduced to Aeon's End: Legacy of Gravehold, including the Boost/Overheat cards.

[B]I did buy a Reset kit for Legacy of Gravehold and hope to setup a Legacy version of that game in the future.[/b]

I have some ideas on homebrewing versions of Z'hana and Brama so they work as normal Nemesis fights, so we'll see where that goes.

    ["White"]  = "f6d8d7",

function sendToNemesisDiscard(playerColor)
    local obj = Player[playerColor].getHoverObject()
    if not obj or obj.tag ~= "Card" then
        return
    end

    local targetColor = nil
    local zones = obj.getZones()
    for _, zone in ipairs(zones) do
        local zoneGuid = zone.getGUID()
        for color, handGuid in pairs(handZones) do
            if zoneGuid == handGuid then
                targetColor = color
                break
            end
        end
        if targetColor then break end
    end

    if targetColor then
        local guid = discardZones[targetColor]
        if guid then
            local discardZone = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if discardZone then
                obj.setPosition(discardZone.getPosition() + vector(0, 2, 0))
                obj.setRotation({0, 180, 0})
            end
        end
    else
        local nemesisDiscard = getObjectFromGUID("f93722")
        if nemesisDiscard then
            local nemesisBoard = getObjectFromGUID("d3fa17")
            if nemesisBoard then
                nemesisBoard.call("clearOrphanTokens", obj.getGUID())
            end
            obj.setPosition(nemesisDiscard.getPosition() + vector(0, 2, 0))
            obj.setRotation({0, 180, 0})
            Wait.time(function()
                if nemesisBoard then
                    nemesisBoard.call("rearrangeNemesisCards")
                end
            end, 0.2)
        end
    end
end

function revealTopCard(deckGUID)
  _revealDeckGUID = deckGUID
  startLuaCoroutine(Global, "revealTopCard_coroutine")
end

function revealTopCard_coroutine()
  local guid = _revealDeckGUID
  _revealDeckGUID = nil
  local deck = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
  if not deck then return 1 end

  while deck.spawning do
    coroutine.yield(0)
    deck = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
  end

  local stationary, target = 0, 60
  local oldPos = deck.getPosition()
  while stationary < target do
    coroutine.yield(0)
    deck = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if not deck then return 1 end
    local newPos = deck.getPosition()
    local moved = math.abs(newPos.x - oldPos.x) > 0.01
               or math.abs(newPos.y - oldPos.y) > 0.01
               or math.abs(newPos.z - oldPos.z) > 0.01
               or deck.isSmoothMoving()
    if moved then
      stationary = 0
      oldPos = newPos
    else
      stationary = stationary + 1
    end
  end

  local pos = deck.getPosition()
  deck.takeObject({
    position = {pos.x, pos.y + 1, pos.z},
    rotation = {0, 180, 0},
    smooth = true
  })
  return 1
end

--Alters scale of elements and moves them
function changeTableScale(width, depth)
    --Scaling factors used to translate scale to position offset
    local width2pos = (width-1) * 18
    local depth2pos = (depth-1) * 18

    --Hand zone movement
    if checkData.move == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                moveHandZone(Player[pc], width2pos, depth2pos)
            end
        end
    end
    --Hand zone scaling
    --The button to enable this was disabled for technical reasons
    if checkData.scale == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                scaleHandZone(Player[pc], width, depth)
            end
        end
    end

    --Resizing table elements
    obj_side_top.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_bot.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_lef.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_side_rig.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_surface.setScale({width, 1, depth})

--Move hand zone, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function moveHandZone(p, width2pos, depth2pos)
    local widthX = obj_side_rig.getPosition().x
    local depthZ = obj_side_top.getPosition().z
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local pos = handT.position
        local y = handT.rotation.y

        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            if pos.z > 0 then
                pos.z = pos.z + depth2pos - depthZ
            else
                pos.z = pos.z - depth2pos + depthZ
            end
        else
            if pos.x > 0 then
                pos.x = pos.x + width2pos - widthX
            else
                pos.x = pos.x - width2pos + widthX
            end
        end

        --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
        --pos.y = tableHeightOffset + 14

        handT.position = pos
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end


---Scales hand zones, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function scaleHandZone(p, width, depth)
    local widthFact = width / obj_side_top.getScale().x
    local depthFact = depth / obj_side_lef.getScale().x
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local scale = handT.scale
        local y = handT.rotation.y
        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            scale.x = scale.x * widthFact
        else
            scale.x = scale.x * depthFact
        end
        handT.scale = scale
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end

--Locates a string saved within memory file
function findInImageDataIndex(...)
    for _, str in ipairs({...}) do
        for i, v in ipairs(tableImageData) do
            if v.url == str or v.name == str then
                return i
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

--Locates a button with a helper function
function findButton(obj, func)
    if func==nil then error("No func supplied to findButton") end
    for _, v in ipairs(obj.getButtons()) do
        if func(v) then
            return v
        end
    end
    return nil
end

        return getObjectFromGUID(gem_random_script), getObjectFromGUID(gem_random_deck_id), "Gem"
    elseif deckObj.hasTag("spellDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("spellCard") then
        return getObjectFromGUID(spell_random_script), getObjectFromGUID(spell_random_deck_id), "Spell"
    elseif deckObj.hasTag("relicDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("relicCard") then
        return getObjectFromGUID(relic_random_script), getObjectFromGUID(relic_random_deck_id), "Relic"
    end
    return nil, nil, nil
end

function setDecks()
  local gemDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(gem_random_script))
  if gemDeck == nil then
    broadcastToAll("Gem Randomiser Deck not found in zone!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
    return
  elseif gemDeck.tag == "Card" then
    return
  end
  gem_random_deck_id = gemDeck.getGUID()
  gemDeck.shuffle()

  local relicDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(relic_random_script))
  if relicDeck == nil then
    broadcastToAll("Relic Randomiser Deck not found in zone!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
    return
  elseif relicDeck.tag == "Card" then
    return
  end
  relic_random_deck_id = relicDeck.getGUID()
  relicDeck.shuffle()

  local spellDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(spell_random_script))
  if spellDeck == nil then
    broadcastToAll("Spell Randomiser Deck not found in zone!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
    return
  elseif spellDeck.tag == "Card" then
    return
  end
  spell_random_deck_id = spellDeck.getGUID()
  spellDeck.shuffle()
end

function findDecksInZone(zone)
    local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
    local decksFound = {}
    for i, object in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
        if object.tag == "Deck" or object.tag == "Card" then
            return getObjectFromGUID(object.guid)
        end
    end
    if #decksFound > 0 then
        return decksFound
    else
        return nil
    end
end

function onLoad()
    for i, v in pairs(buttonParameters) do

function rerollCard(pos, altclick)
    local deckObj = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(zoneTable[pos]))
    if deckObj == nil then
        broadcastToAll("No cards found at market position " .. tostring(pos) .. "!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return
    end

    -- 获取 deck 类型
    local deckType = ""
    if deckObj.hasTag("gemDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("gemCard") then
        deckType = "Gem"
    elseif deckObj.hasTag("spellDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("spellCard") then
        deckType = "Spell"
    elseif deckObj.hasTag("relicDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("relicCard") then
        deckType = "Relic"
    else
        broadcastToAll("Invalid deck type at position " .. tostring(pos) .. "!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return
    end

    -- 获取当前费用
    local currentCost = nil
    if deckObj.getGMNotes() and deckObj.getGMNotes() ~= "" then
        currentCost = tonumber(deckObj.getGMNotes())
    end
    if currentCost == nil then
        broadcastToAll("Invalid cost at position " .. tostring(pos) .. "!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return
    end

    -- 确定目标费用
    local targetCost = currentCost
    if cost_plus then
        cost_plus = false
        targetCost = currentCost + 1
    elseif cost_minus then
        cost_minus = false
        targetCost = currentCost - 1
    end

    -- 检查目标费用是否在范围内
    local minCost, maxCost
    if deckType == "Gem" then
        minCost, maxCost = 2, 7
    elseif deckType == "Relic" then
        minCost, maxCost = 1, 8
    else
        minCost, maxCost = 1, 9
    end

    if targetCost < minCost then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot decrease " .. deckType .. " cost below " .. minCost .. "!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return
    end
    if targetCost > maxCost then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot increase " .. deckType .. " cost above " .. maxCost .. "!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return
    end

    -- 获取 market deck 的名称（用于匹配 barracks 中的卡）
    local deckName = deckObj.getName()

    -- 获取位置信息
    local destroyObj = getObjectFromGUID(destroyID)
    local destroyPos = destroyObj.getPosition() + vector(0, 2, 0)
    local targetZone = getObjectFromGUID(zoneTable[pos])
    local targetPos = targetZone.getPosition() + vector(0, 3, 0)

    -- ========== 第一步：检查 randomiser 中是否有匹配的卡 ==========
    local foundCardLocation = nil  -- "zone" 或 "deck"
    local foundCardData = nil      -- card 数据表或 LuaObject

    -- 检查 randomiser zone 内是否有单张卡
    local randomiserZone, _, _ = getRandomiserZoneAndDeck(deckObj)
    if randomiserZone then
        local objectsInZone = randomiserZone.getObjects(true)
        for _, obj in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
            if obj.type == "Card" then
                local cardObj = getObjectFromGUID(obj.guid)
                if cardObj then
                    local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
                    local costStr = desc:match("%d+")
                    if costStr and tonumber(costStr) == targetCost then
                        foundCardLocation = "zone"
                        foundCardData = cardObj
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 如果没有在 zone 内找到，检查 deck 内是否有
    if foundCardLocation == nil then
        local randomiserDeck = nil
        if deckObj.hasTag("gemDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("gemCard") then
            randomiserDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(gem_random_script))
        elseif deckObj.hasTag("spellDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("spellCard") then
            randomiserDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(spell_random_script))
        elseif deckObj.hasTag("relicDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("relicCard") then
            randomiserDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(relic_random_script))
        end

        if randomiserDeck then
            local cardsInDeck = nil
            if randomiserDeck.tag == "Deck" or randomiserDeck.tag == "Bag" then
                cardsInDeck = randomiserDeck.getObjects()
            elseif randomiserDeck.tag == "Card" then
                cardsInDeck = {randomiserDeck}
            end

            if cardsInDeck then
                for _, card in ipairs(cardsInDeck) do
                    local desc = ""
                    if type(card) == "table" then
                        desc = card.description or ""
                    else
                        desc = card.getDescription() or ""
                    end
                    local costStr = desc:match("%d+")
                    if costStr and tonumber(costStr) == targetCost then
                        foundCardLocation = "deck"
                        foundCardData = card
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 如果没有找到匹配的卡，直接返回，不移动任何东西
    if foundCardLocation == nil then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot find a Cost" .. tostring(targetCost) .. " " .. deckType .. " randomizer card!", {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return
    end

    -- ========== 第二步：找到了匹配的卡，开始替换 ==========

    -- 先从 Barracks 取出同名卡放到 destroy 位置
    local barracksDeck = getObjectFromGUID(barracksID)
    if barracksDeck then
        local barracksCards = barracksDeck.getObjects()
        if barracksCards then
            for _, card in ipairs(barracksCards) do
                if card.name == deckName then
                    barracksDeck.takeObject({
                        guid = card.guid,
                        position = destroyPos,
                        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
                        smooth = false
                    })
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 移动 market deck 到 destroy 位置
    deckObj.setPosition(destroyObj.getPosition() + vector(0, 5, 0))

    -- 从 randomiser 中取出/移动找到的卡到 market 位置
    if foundCardLocation == "zone" then
        -- 卡在 zone 内，直接移动
        foundCardData.setPosition(targetPos)
        foundCardData.setRotation({0, 180, 0})
    else
        -- 卡在 deck 内，用 takeObject 取出
        local randomiserDeck = nil
        if deckObj.hasTag("gemDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("gemCard") then
            randomiserDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(gem_random_script))
        elseif deckObj.hasTag("spellDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("spellCard") then
            randomiserDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(spell_random_script))
        elseif deckObj.hasTag("relicDeck") or deckObj.hasTag("relicCard") then
            randomiserDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(relic_random_script))
        end

        if randomiserDeck then
            if type(foundCardData) == "table" then
                randomiserDeck.takeObject({
                    guid = foundCardData.guid,
                    position = targetPos,
                    rotation = {0, 180, 0},
                    smooth = false
                })
            else
                foundCardData.setPosition(targetPos)
                foundCardData.setRotation({0, 180, 0})
            end
        end
    end
end

function grabCard(color, error, myDeck)
    deckObj = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDeck))
    if deckObj == nil then
        broadcastToAll(error, {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return (nil)
    end
    if color == "White" then
        myBoard = playerBoardGUID[1]
    elseif color == "Orange" then
        myBoard = playerBoardGUID[2]
    elseif color == "Blue" then
        myBoard = playerBoardGUID[3]
    elseif color == "Purple" then
        myBoard = playerBoardGUID[4]
    end
    local boardPos = getObjectFromGUID(myBoard)
    if deckObj.type == "Card" then
        deckObj.setPositionSmooth(boardPos.getPosition() + vector(14, 3, -6.4),false,true)
        deckObj.setRotationSmooth({0.00, 180.00, 0.00})
    elseif deckObj.type == "Deck" then
      deckObj.takeObject({
        position = deckObj.getPosition(),
        smooth = false,
        rotation = {0.00, 180.00, 0.00},
        callback_function = function(obj)
          if obj then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(boardPos.getPosition() + vector(14, 3, -6.4), false, true)
          end
        end
      })
    end
end

function buyCard(pos, playerC)
    local myDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(zoneTable[pos]))
    grabCard(playerC, "No cards found at market position " .. tostring(pos) .. "!", zoneTable[pos])
end


function getShopCard(box, type, pos)
    cardBox = getObjectFromGUID(marketBags[box])
    cardBoxSize = tablelength(cardBox.getObjects())
    if cardBoxSize == 0 then
      broadcastToAll("You've either ran out of cards to randomise or something went wrong!\nYou may have to fix this manually, grab a card from the randomiser decks!",{r=1,g=0.7,b=0.7})
      return
    end
    local myCost = box
    if type == "Gem" then
          searchDeck(getObjectFromGUID(gem_random_deck_id),myCost, pos.getPosition() +vector(0, 5 + barracksOffset, 0),{0,180,0},"Des","Cannot find a " .. myCost .. " randomizer card in deck.")
    elseif type == "Relic" then
        searchDeck(getObjectFromGUID(relic_random_deck_id),myCost,pos.getPosition() + vector(0, 5 + barracksOffset, 0),{0,180,0},"Des","Cannot find a " .. myCost .. " randomizer card in deck.")
    elseif type == "Spell" then
        searchDeck(getObjectFromGUID(spell_random_deck_id),myCost,pos.getPosition() + vector(0, 5 + barracksOffset, 0),{0,180,0},"Des","Cannot find a " .. myCost .. " randomizer card in deck.")
    end
    barracksOffset = barracksOffset + 1
    Wait.time(resetOffset,6)
end

function tablelength(T)
  local count = 0
  for _ in pairs(T) do count = count + 1 end
  return count
end

function lockMarket()
    for i = 1, 9, 1 do
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zoneTable[i])
        local objects = zone.getObjects()
        local hasCard = false
        for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
            if obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "Deck" then
                hasCard = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not hasCard then
            broadcastToAll("Empty Supply detected! Please set up the market correctly first!", {r = 1, g = 0.6, b = 0})
            return
        end
    end

    locked = true
    for i = 10, 27, 1 do
        self.removeButton(i)
    end
    for i = 0, 8, 1 do
        self.editButton({
            index = i,
            label = "Buy/Gain",
            width = 384,
            height = 180,
            scale = {0.4, 0.4, 0.4},
            tooltip = "Adds the above card to your discard pile."
        })
    end
    self.editButton({
        index = 9,
        label = "Unlock",
        click_function = "unlockMarket",
        tooltip = "Unlocks the market and restores the re-roll buttons."
    })
    broadcastToAll("Market has been locked!", {r = 0, g = 1, b = 0.3})
    local m1 = getObjectFromGUID('b9111a')
    if m1 then m1.setVar('marketDone', true) end
    local m2 = getObjectFromGUID('184d8b')
    if m2 then m2.setVar('marketDone', true) end
end

function unlockMarket()
    locked = false
    for i = 0, 8, 1 do
        self.editButton({
            index = i,
            label = "Re",
            width = 160,
            height = 90,
            scale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
            tooltip = "Reroll for same cost."
        })
    end
    for key, params in pairs(buttonParameters) do
        if key:find("p") or key:find("m") then
            self.createButton(params)
        end
    end
    self.editButton({
        index = 9,
        label = "Lock Market",
        click_function = "lockMarket",
        tooltip = "Locks in the market - This replaces the re-roll buttons with buy/gain buttons!"
    })
    broadcastToAll("Market has been unlocked!", {r = 0, g = 1, b = 0.3})
    local m1 = getObjectFromGUID('b9111a')
    if m1 then m1.setVar('marketDone', false) end
    local m2 = getObjectFromGUID('184d8b')
    if m2 then m2.setVar('marketDone', false) end
end

function checkZone(zone)
    for i = 0, 9, 1 do
        if zone.getGUID() == zoneTable[i] then
            return (true)
        end
    end
    return (false)
end

function onObjectEnterScriptingZone(zone, info)
    local foundZone = checkZone(zone)
    if foundZone == false or info == nil then
        return
    end
    if (foundZone == true and (info.getGMNotes() ~= "Swap Randomiser" and info.getGMNotes() ~= "Market Randomiser" and info.getGMNotes() ~= "Market Randomizer")) then
        return
    else
        if (foundZone == true) then
          local error = ''
          if (preventError == false) then
            error = "No market card by the name '" ..
                info.getName() .. "' found. \n The card is supposed to be in bag: " .. info.getDescription()
          end
            local myZone = getObjectFromGUID(zone.getGUID())
            searchDeck(
                getObjectFromGUID(marketBags[info.getDescription()]),
                info.getName(),
                myZone.getPosition() + vector(0, 4, 0),
                {0, 180, 0},
                "Name",
                error
            )
            local myPos2 = getObjectFromGUID("d089df").getPosition()
            info.setPosition(myPos2 + vector(0, 8 + barracksOffset, 0), false, true)
            info.setRotation({0, 180, 0})
            barracksOffset = barracksOffset + 1
            Wait.time(resetOffset,2)
            preventError = true
            Wait.time(resetError,4)
        end
        if info.getGMNotes() == "Swap Randomiser" then
            error = "No swap market card by the name '" ..
            swapDictionary[info.getName()] .. "' found. \n The card is supposed to be in bag: " .. swapBag
            searchDeck(
                getObjectFromGUID(swapBag),
                swapDictionary[info.getName()],
                swapPosition + vector(swapCount * 2.9, 4, 0),
                {0, 180, 0},
                "Name",
                error
            )
            --printToAll("The Swap card " .. swapDictionary[info.getName()] .. " has been added to the Swap Zone.", {r = 1, g = 1, b = 0.8})
            swapCount = swapCount + 1
        end
    end
end

function searchDeck(deck, charName, pos, rot, nameOrDes, error)
    -- 修复：添加 deck 为 nil 的检查
    if deck == nil then
        local myError = error or "Deck object is nil"
        broadcastToAll(myError, {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return nil
    end

    local objects = deck.getObjects()
    -- 修复：添加 getObjects() 返回 nil 的检查（单张卡时可能出现）
    if objects == nil then
        local myError = error or "Deck has no objects (may be a single card)"
        broadcastToAll(myError, {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
        return nil
    end

    for _, card in pairs(objects) do
        if (nameOrDes == "Des" and card.description == charName) or (nameOrDes == "Name" and card.name == charName) then
            return (deck.takeObject({guid = card.guid, position = pos, rotation = rot, smooth = false}))
        end
    end
    local myError = error or ""
    if (myError ~= "") then
        broadcastToAll(error, {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
    end
end

function ability()
  if (canContinue == false) then
    return(nil)
  end
    local charge_button = getObjectFromGUID('f49f3e')
    if charge_button ~= nil then
      getObjectFromGUID('f49f3e').setVar('chargeCounter',0)
    end
    tokenObject = getObjectFromGUID(myTokens)
    findTokensInZone(tokenObject)
end


function findTokensInZone(zone)
    local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
    local decksFound = {}
    local locBag = getObjectFromGUID(myBag)
    for i, object in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
        if object.getName() == "Charge Token" then
            object.setPositionSmooth(locBag.getPosition() + vector(0,i*2,0), false, false)
        end
    end
end


function chargeButtonClick(obj, player, alt_click)

    if canContinue then
      reorganize_charges()
      if alt_click == false then -- left_click
          gain_charge()
          Wait.time(enable_continue,0.16)
      elseif alt_click == true then -- right_click
          lose_charge()
      end
    end
end


function gain_charge()
    canContinue = false
    local snapList = getOrderedSnapPoints(charge_zone)
    local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)
    MageCharge = #snapList
    chargeCounter = chargeCounter + 1
    if MageCharge == 0 then
      chargeCounter = 0
      return
    end
    if chargeCounter > MageCharge then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot Place More Charge Token", {1,0,0})
        chargeCounter = chargeCounter - 1
        return
    end
    local targetPos = snapList[chargeCounter].position:copy()
    targetPos.y = 2.5

    tokenBag.takeObject({
      position = tokenBag.getPosition(),
      smooth = false,
      callback_function = function(obj)
          if obj then
              obj.setPositionSmooth(targetPos, false, true)  -- 启用快速移动
          end
      end
    })

end

function lose_charge()
  local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)
  local zone = getObjectFromGUID(charge_zone)
  local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
  local inZoneTokens = {}
  for _, obj in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
    if obj.getName() == "Charge Token" then
        table.insert(inZoneTokens, obj)
    end
  end
  if #inZoneTokens > 0 then
    table.sort(inZoneTokens, function(a,b)
        return a.getPosition().x > b.getPosition().x
    end)

    -- 回收最右侧代币
    tokenBag.putObject(inZoneTokens[1])
    chargeCounter = math.max(0, chargeCounter - 1)
  else
    return
  end

end

function getOrderedSnapPoints(zoneGUID)
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zoneGUID)
    local zonePos = zone.getPosition()
    local zoneScale = zone.getScale()
    local minX, maxX = zonePos.x - zoneScale.x/2, zonePos.x + zoneScale.x/2
    local minZ, maxZ = zonePos.z - zoneScale.z/2, zonePos.z + zoneScale.z/2

    local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()

    local validPoints = 0
    local points = {}

    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        for _, sp in ipairs(obj.getSnapPoints() or {}) do
            local worldPos = obj.positionToWorld(sp.position)
            if worldPos.x >= minX and worldPos.x <= maxX
            and worldPos.z >= minZ and worldPos.z <= maxZ then
                validPoints = validPoints + 1
                table.insert(points, {
                    position = worldPos,
                    source = obj
                })
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(points, function(a,b) return a.position.x < b.position.x end)
    return points
end

function reorganize_charges()
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(charge_zone)
    local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)

    local existingTokens = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.getName() == "Charge Token" then
            table.insert(existingTokens, obj)
        end
    end

    table.sort(existingTokens, function(a,b) return a.getPosition().x < b.getPosition().x end)
    local snapList = getOrderedSnapPoints(charge_zone)

    -- 重新排列token
    for i = 1, math.min(#snapList, #existingTokens) do
        local token = existingTokens[i]
        local currentPos = token.getPosition()
        local targetPos = snapList[i].position:copy()

        -- 仅修改XZ坐标，保持原有Y轴高度
        targetPos:setAt('y', currentPos.y)    -- 保持原始高度
        targetPos:setAt('x', targetPos.x)     -- 使用吸附点X坐标
        targetPos:setAt('z', targetPos.z)     -- 使用吸附点Z坐标

        -- 仅在需要移动时更新位置
        if currentPos:distance(targetPos) > 0.1 then
            token.setPositionSmooth(targetPos, false, true)
        end
    end

    -- 优化计数器更新逻辑
    chargeCounter = math.min(#existingTokens, #snapList)
end

function draw5()
  local cDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDeck))
  local cDiscard = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard))
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  local cCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
  if cCount < myCount then
    if cDeck ~= nil then
      Wait.time(checkDeck, 30/60)
    end
    local drawX = myCount - cCount
    for i = 1, drawX, 1 do
      cDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDeck))
      if cDeck ~= nil then
        cDeck.deal(1, myPlayer)
      else
        if cDiscard == nil then
          if (Player[myPlayer].seated == true) then
            printToColor("Cannot flip Discard Pile.", myPlayer, {r=1,g=0,b=0})
          end
          return(nil)
        end
        flipDeck()
        Wait.time(draw5, 0.3)
        break
      end
    end
  else
    if (Player[myPlayer].seated == true) then
      broadcastToColor("Your hand already has " .. tostring(cCount) .. " cards", myPlayer, {r=1, g=1, b= 0})
    end
  end
end

function checkDeck()
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  local cCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
  if cCount < myCount then
    draw5()
  end
end

function draw1()
  local cDeck = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDeck))
  local cDiscard = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard))
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  if cDeck ~= nil then

  else
    if cDiscard == nil then
      if (Player[myPlayer].seated == true) then
        printToColor("Cannot flip Discard Pile.", myPlayer, {r=1,g=0,b=0})
      end
      return(nil)
    end
    flipDeck()
    Wait.time(draw1, 0.3)
  end
end

function flipDeck()
  local cDiscard = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard))
  local deckPos = getObjectFromGUID(myDeck)
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  if cDiscard ~= nil then
    local moveParam = deckPos.getPosition()
    cDiscard.setPositionSmooth(moveParam, false, true)
    cDiscard.setRotation({0.00, 180.00, 180.00})
  else
    if (#owner.seated == true) then
      printToColor("Cannot flip Discard Pile.", myPlayer, {r=1,g=0,b=0})
    end
  end
end

function findDecksInZone(zone)
  local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
  for i, object in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
    if object.tag == "Deck" or object.tag == "Card" then
      return getObjectFromGUID(object.guid)
    end
  end
  return nil
end

function sendHand(obj, color, alt_click)
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  altC = alt_click
  handCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
  if (#owner.getHandObjects() ~= 0) then
    loopCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
    waitFunct = Wait.time(moveCard, 0.1, #owner.getHandObjects())
  else
    if (Player[myPlayer].seated) then
      broadcastToColor("You have no hand.", myPlayer, {r = 1, g = 1, b = 0})
    end
  end
end

function moveCard()
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  handCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
  loopCount = loopCount - 1
  local deckPos = getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard)
  local moveParam = deckPos.getPosition() + vector(0, 1.4, 0)
  local hand = Player[myPlayer].getHandObjects(1)

  for i, object in ipairs(hand) do
    if (object.hasTag("tokenCard") == false) then
      if object.type == "Card" and ((object.hasTag("spellCard") == false and object.hasTag("nemesisDeckCard") == false) or altC == true) and i == cCard then
        card = object
      elseif object.type == "Card" and (object.hasTag("spellCard") == true or object.hasTag("nemesisDeckCard") == true) and i == cCard then
        cCard = cCard + 1
      end
    elseif (object.hasTag("tokenCard") == true) then
      object.destruct()
    end
  end
  if (card ~= nil) then
    card.setPosition(moveParam, false, true)
    card.setRotation({0.00, 180.00, 0})
  end
  handCount = #owner.getHandObjects()

  if loopCount <= 0 then
    resetCount()
    loopCount = -1
    return(nil)
  end
end

function resetCount()
  cCard = 1
end

function checkRecallInDiscard()
    local discardZone = getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard)
    if discardZone == nil then return 0 end

    local recallCount = 0
    local objects = discardZone.getObjects()
    for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
        if obj.type == "Card" then
            if obj.hasTag("RecallCard") then
                recallCount = recallCount + 1
            end
        elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
            local cards = obj.getObjects()
            for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
                if card.tags and type(card.tags) == "table" then
                    for _, tag in ipairs(card.tags) do
                        if tag == "RecallCard" then
                            recallCount = recallCount + 1
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return recallCount
end

    local existing = self.getButtons()
    local recallBtnIndex = nil

function gain_charge()
    canContinue = false
    local snapList = getOrderedSnapPoints(charge_zone)
    local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)
    MageCharge = #snapList
    chargeCounter = chargeCounter + 1
    if MageCharge == 0 then
      chargeCounter = 0
      return
    end
    if chargeCounter > MageCharge then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot Place More Charge Token", {1,0,0})
        chargeCounter = chargeCounter - 1
        return
    end
    local targetPos = snapList[chargeCounter].position:copy()
    targetPos.y = 2.5

    tokenBag.takeObject({
      position = tokenBag.getPosition(),
      smooth = false,
      callback_function = function(obj)
          if obj then
              obj.setPositionSmooth(targetPos, false, true)  -- 启用快速移动
          end
      end
    })

end

function lose_charge()
  local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)
  local zone = getObjectFromGUID(charge_zone)
  local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
  local inZoneTokens = {}
  for _, obj in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
    if obj.getName() == "Charge Token" then
        table.insert(inZoneTokens, obj)
    end
  end
  if #inZoneTokens > 0 then
    table.sort(inZoneTokens, function(a,b)
        return a.getPosition().x > b.getPosition().x
    end)

    -- 回收最右侧代币
    tokenBag.putObject(inZoneTokens[1])
    chargeCounter = math.max(0, chargeCounter - 1)
  else
    return
  end

end

function getOrderedSnapPoints(zoneGUID)
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zoneGUID)
    local zonePos = zone.getPosition()
    local zoneScale = zone.getScale()
    local minX, maxX = zonePos.x - zoneScale.x/2, zonePos.x + zoneScale.x/2
    local minZ, maxZ = zonePos.z - zoneScale.z/2, zonePos.z + zoneScale.z/2

    local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()

    local validPoints = 0
    local points = {}

    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        for _, sp in ipairs(obj.getSnapPoints() or {}) do
            local worldPos = obj.positionToWorld(sp.position)
            if worldPos.x >= minX and worldPos.x <= maxX
            and worldPos.z >= minZ and worldPos.z <= maxZ then
                validPoints = validPoints + 1
                table.insert(points, {
                    position = worldPos,
                    source = obj
                })
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(points, function(a,b) return a.position.x < b.position.x end)
    return points
end

function reorganize_charges()
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(charge_zone)
    local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)

    local existingTokens = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.getName() == "Charge Token" then
            table.insert(existingTokens, obj)
        end
    end

    table.sort(existingTokens, function(a,b) return a.getPosition().x < b.getPosition().x end)
    local snapList = getOrderedSnapPoints(charge_zone)

    -- 重新排列token
    for i = 1, math.min(#snapList, #existingTokens) do
        local token = existingTokens[i]
        local currentPos = token.getPosition()
        local targetPos = snapList[i].position:copy()

        -- 仅修改XZ坐标，保持原有Y轴高度
        targetPos:setAt('y', currentPos.y)    -- 保持原始高度
        targetPos:setAt('x', targetPos.x)     -- 使用吸附点X坐标
        targetPos:setAt('z', targetPos.z)     -- 使用吸附点Z坐标

        -- 仅在需要移动时更新位置
        if currentPos:distance(targetPos) > 0.1 then
            token.setPositionSmooth(targetPos, false, true)
        end
    end

    -- 优化计数器更新逻辑
    chargeCounter = math.min(#existingTokens, #snapList)
end

  local deckPos = getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard)
  local moveParam = deckPos.getPosition() + vector(0, 1.4, 0)

function checkRecallInDiscard()
    local discardZone = getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard)
    if discardZone == nil then return 0 end

    local recallCount = 0
    local objects = discardZone.getObjects()
    for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
        if obj.type == "Card" then
            if obj.hasTag("RecallCard") then
                recallCount = recallCount + 1
            end
        elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
            local cards = obj.getObjects()
            for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
                if card.tags and type(card.tags) == "table" then
                    for _, tag in ipairs(card.tags) do
                        if tag == "RecallCard" then
                            recallCount = recallCount + 1
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return recallCount
end

    end

end


function findTokensInZone(zone)
    local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
    local decksFound = {}
    local locBag = getObjectFromGUID(myBag)
    for i, object in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
        if object.getName() == "Charge Token" then

        end

end


function chargeButtonClick(obj, player, alt_click)

    if canContinue then
      reorganize_charges()
      if alt_click == false then -- left_click
          gain_charge()
          Wait.time(enable_continue,0.16)
      elseif alt_click == true then -- right_click
          lose_charge()
      end
    end
end


function gain_charge()
    canContinue = false
    local snapList = getOrderedSnapPoints(charge_zone)
    local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)
    MageCharge = #snapList
    chargeCounter = chargeCounter + 1
    if MageCharge == 0 then
      chargeCounter = 0
      return
    end
    if chargeCounter > MageCharge then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot Place More Charge Token", {1,0,0})
        chargeCounter = chargeCounter - 1
        return
    end
    local targetPos = snapList[chargeCounter].position:copy()
    targetPos.y = 2.5

    tokenBag.takeObject({
      position = tokenBag.getPosition(),
      smooth = false,
      callback_function = function(obj)
          if obj then
              obj.setPositionSmooth(targetPos, false, true)  -- 启用快速移动
          end
      end
    })

end

function lose_charge()
  local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)
  local zone = getObjectFromGUID(charge_zone)
  local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
  local inZoneTokens = {}
  for _, obj in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
    if obj.getName() == "Charge Token" then
        table.insert(inZoneTokens, obj)
    end
  end
  if #inZoneTokens > 0 then
    table.sort(inZoneTokens, function(a,b)
        return a.getPosition().x > b.getPosition().x
    end)

    -- 回收最右侧代币
    tokenBag.putObject(inZoneTokens[1])
    chargeCounter = math.max(0, chargeCounter - 1)
  else
    return
  end

end

function getOrderedSnapPoints(zoneGUID)
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zoneGUID)
    local zonePos = zone.getPosition()
    local zoneScale = zone.getScale()
    local minX, maxX = zonePos.x - zoneScale.x/2, zonePos.x + zoneScale.x/2
    local minZ, maxZ = zonePos.z - zoneScale.z/2, zonePos.z + zoneScale.z/2

    local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()

    local validPoints = 0
    local points = {}

    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        for _, sp in ipairs(obj.getSnapPoints() or {}) do
            local worldPos = obj.positionToWorld(sp.position)
            if worldPos.x >= minX and worldPos.x <= maxX
            and worldPos.z >= minZ and worldPos.z <= maxZ then
                validPoints = validPoints + 1
                table.insert(points, {
                    position = worldPos,
                    source = obj
                })
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(points, function(a,b) return a.position.x < b.position.x end)
    return points
end

function reorganize_charges()
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(charge_zone)
    local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID(charge_token_bag)

    local existingTokens = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.getName() == "Charge Token" then
            table.insert(existingTokens, obj)
        end
    end

    table.sort(existingTokens, function(a,b) return a.getPosition().x < b.getPosition().x end)
    local snapList = getOrderedSnapPoints(charge_zone)

    -- 重新排列token
    for i = 1, math.min(#snapList, #existingTokens) do
        local token = existingTokens[i]
        local currentPos = token.getPosition()
        local targetPos = snapList[i].position:copy()

        -- 仅修改XZ坐标，保持原有Y轴高度
        targetPos:setAt('y', currentPos.y)    -- 保持原始高度
        targetPos:setAt('x', targetPos.x)     -- 使用吸附点X坐标
        targetPos:setAt('z', targetPos.z)     -- 使用吸附点Z坐标

        -- 仅在需要移动时更新位置
        if currentPos:distance(targetPos) > 0.1 then
            token.setPositionSmooth(targetPos, false, true)
        end
    end

    -- 优化计数器更新逻辑
    chargeCounter = math.min(#existingTokens, #snapList)
end

  canContinue = true
end

          end

    end
  else
    if (Player[myPlayer].seated == true) then
      broadcastToColor("Your hand already has " .. tostring(cCount) .. " cards", myPlayer, {r=1, g=1, b= 0})
    end
  end
end

function checkDeck()

function draw1()

function flipDeck()

  local deckPos = getObjectFromGUID(myDeck)
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  if cDiscard ~= nil then
    local moveParam = deckPos.getPosition()
    cDiscard.setPositionSmooth(moveParam, false, true)
    cDiscard.setRotation({0.00, 180.00, 180.00})
  else
    if (#owner.seated == true) then
      printToColor("Cannot flip Discard Pile.", myPlayer, {r=1,g=0,b=0})
    end
  end
end

function findDecksInZone(zone)
  local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
  for i, object in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
    if object.tag == "Deck" or object.tag == "Card" then
      return getObjectFromGUID(object.guid)
    end
  end
  return nil
end

function sendHand(obj, color, alt_click)
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  altC = alt_click
  handCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
  if (#owner.getHandObjects() ~= 0) then
    loopCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
    waitFunct = Wait.time(moveCard, 0.1, #owner.getHandObjects())
  else
    if (Player[myPlayer].seated) then
      broadcastToColor("You have no hand.", myPlayer, {r = 1, g = 1, b = 0})
    end
  end
end

function moveCard()
  local owner = Player[myPlayer]
  handCount = #owner.getHandObjects()
  loopCount = loopCount - 1
  local deckPos = getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard)
  local moveParam = deckPos.getPosition() + vector(0, 1.4, 0)
  local hand = Player[myPlayer].getHandObjects(1)

  for i, object in ipairs(hand) do
    if (object.hasTag("tokenCard") == false) then
      if object.type == "Card" and ((object.hasTag("spellCard") == false and object.hasTag("nemesisDeckCard") == false) or altC == true) and i == cCard then
        card = object
      elseif object.type == "Card" and (object.hasTag("spellCard") == true or object.hasTag("nemesisDeckCard") == true) and i == cCard then
        cCard = cCard + 1
      end
    elseif (object.hasTag("tokenCard") == true) then
      object.destruct()
    end
  end
  if (card ~= nil) then
    card.setPosition(moveParam, false, true)
    card.setRotation({0.00, 180.00, 0})
  end
  handCount = #owner.getHandObjects()

  if loopCount <= 0 then
    resetCount()
    loopCount = -1
    return(nil)
  end
end

function resetCount()
  cCard = 1
end

function checkRecallInDiscard()
    local discardZone = getObjectFromGUID(myDiscard)
    if discardZone == nil then return 0 end

    local recallCount = 0
    local objects = discardZone.getObjects()
    for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
        if obj.type == "Card" then
            if obj.hasTag("RecallCard") then
                recallCount = recallCount + 1
            end
        elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
            local cards = obj.getObjects()
            for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
                if card.tags and type(card.tags) == "table" then
                    for _, tag in ipairs(card.tags) do
                        if tag == "RecallCard" then
                            recallCount = recallCount + 1
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return recallCount
end

function updateRecallButton()
    local recallCount = checkRecallInDiscard()
    local existing = self.getButtons()
    local recallBtnIndex = nil
    for i, btn in ipairs(existing) do
        if btn.click_function == "recallButtonClick" then
            recallBtnIndex = i

        end
    end

    if recallCount > 0 then
        if recallBtnIndex == nil then
            local btnParams = {
                click_function = 'recallButtonClick',
                function_owner = self,
                label = 'Recall ' .. tostring(recallCount),
                position = {1.27, 0.1, 1.05},

                height = 550,
                font_size = 250,
                scale = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1},
                tooltip = "Recall cards detected in discard pile!",
                color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}
            }
            self.createButton(btnParams)
        else
            self.editButton({
                index = recallBtnIndex - 1,
                label = 'Recall ' .. tostring(recallCount)
            })
        end
    else
        if recallBtnIndex ~= nil then
            self.removeButton(recallBtnIndex - 1)
        end
    end
end

function recallButtonClick(obj, player, alt_click)
    if player ~= myPlayer then
        return
    end
    broadcastToColor("Do not forget to trigger Recall effects!", myPlayer, {r = 1, g = 0.6, b = 0})
end

bagGUID = ""
function onLoad()
  bagGUID = self.getGUID()
  setupShop_params = {
    click_function = "setupShop",
    function_owner = self,
    label = "Setup Market",
    tooltip = "Auto-sets Market. >9 cards? Even 3-type split. Remaining cards are placed as a deck nearby.",
    position = {0, 0,1.3},
    rotation = {0,0,0},

    color = {1,1,1},
    font_color = {0,0,0},
    font_size = 150
  }
  self.createButton(setupShop_params)

end

function setupShop(params)
    local bag = getObjectFromGUID(bagGUID)
    local cardDatas = bag.getObjects() -- 获取卡牌数据表列表
    local shopSlots = {}
    local bagPosition = bag.getPosition()

    -- 阶段1：数据采集 ----------------------------------------------
    for _, data in ipairs(cardDatas) do
        local desc = data.description
        if desc and (data.gm_notes == "Market Randomiser" or data.gm_notes == "Swap Randomiser") then
            local cardType, value = desc:match("(%a+)(%d+)")
            if cardType and value then
                -- 关键修改：使用takeObject取出卡牌获取真实对象
                local cardObj = bag.takeObject({
                    guid = data.guid,
                    position = bagPosition + vector(0, 5, 0), -- 临时放置位置
                    smooth = false
                })
                -- print("取出卡牌:", cardObj.getGUID())
                table.insert(shopSlots, {
                    obj = cardObj,
                    type = cardType:lower(),
                    value = tonumber(value)
                })
            end
        end
    end

    -- 调试：打印原始数据
    -- print("\n==== 阶段1：数据采集 ====")
    -- print("袋中卡牌总数:", #cardDatas)
    -- print("有效解析卡牌数:", #shopSlots)

    -- 阶段2：智能排序 ----------------------------------------------
    table.sort(shopSlots, function(a,b)
        local typeOrder = {gem=1, relic=2, spell=3}
        -- 优先按类型排序
        if a.type ~= b.type then
            return typeOrder[a.type] < typeOrder[b.type]
        end
        -- 同类型按数值升序
        return a.value < b.value
    end)

    -- 阶段3：智能筛选 ----------------------------------------------
    local finalSelection = {}
    local typeCounts = {gem=0, relic=0, spell=0}
    local remaining = 9

    -- 调试头
    -- print("\n==== 阶段3：筛选过程 ====")

    -- 情况1：刚好9张直接使用
    if #shopSlots == 9 then
        -- print("检测到正好9张卡牌，直接使用全部")
        finalSelection = shopSlots
    else
        -- print("开始智能筛选...")
        -- 情况2：需要筛选时
        for i, card in ipairs(shopSlots) do
            local canSelect = false
            -- local reason = ""

            -- 核心筛选条件
            if remaining > 0 then
                -- 条件A：该类型未达配额（3张）
                if typeCounts[card.type] < 3 then
                    canSelect = true
                    -- reason = "类型配额未满"
                -- 条件B：所有类型都达配额但仍有剩余位置
                elseif typeCounts.gem >=3 and typeCounts.relic >=3 and typeCounts.spell >=3 then
                    canSelect = true
                    -- reason = "强制填充剩余位置"
                end

                if canSelect then
                    table.insert(finalSelection, card)
                    typeCounts[card.type] = typeCounts[card.type] + 1
                    remaining = remaining - 1

                end
            else
                break
            end
        end
    end

    -- 阶段4：布局与调试 --------------------------------------------
    local positions = {
        {28.93,3,23.46}, {36.07,3,23.46}, {43.27,3,23.46},
        {28.93,3,13.75}, {36.07,3,13.75}, {43.32,3,13.75},
        {28.93,3,3.96},  {36.07,3,3.96},  {43.23,3,3.96}
    }

    -- print("\n==== 最终结果 ====")
    -- print("目标位置数:", 9)
    -- print("实际选中数:", #finalSelection)
    -- print("各类型分布:")
    -- print("GEM:", typeCounts.gem, "RELIC:", typeCounts.relic, "SPELL:", typeCounts.spell)

    -- 打印每张卡的详细信息
    for i, card in ipairs(finalSelection) do
        local pos = positions[i] or {"无位置"}
        -- print(string.format("槽位%1d: [%s] %s%-2d → 坐标: %.2f,%.2f,%.2f",
        --     i, card.obj.getGUID(), card.type:upper(), card.value,
        --     pos[1], pos[2], pos[3]))
    end

    -- 执行卡牌摆放
    for i, card in ipairs(finalSelection) do
        if positions[i] then
            card.obj.setPosition(positions[i])
        end
    end

    -- 阶段5：将剩余卡牌堆叠成 deck，放置在 Barracks Storage 正前方 -----------------
    local remainingCards = {}

    -- 5a. 收集未被选中到市场的已取出卡牌
    for _, card in ipairs(shopSlots) do
        local isSelected = false
        for _, sel in ipairs(finalSelection) do
            if card.obj == sel.obj then
                isSelected = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not isSelected then
            table.insert(remainingCards, card.obj)
        end
    end

    -- 5b. 取出 bag 中剩余的卡牌
    local bagRemaining = bag.getObjects()
    for _, data in ipairs(bagRemaining) do
        local obj = bag.takeObject({
            guid = data.guid,
            position = bagPosition + vector(0, 5, 0),
            smooth = false
        })
        table.insert(remainingCards, obj)
    end

    -- 5c. 将所有剩余卡牌移到同一位置形成 deck
    if #remainingCards > 0 then
        local deckPosition = bagPosition + vector(7, 0, 0)
        for _, obj in ipairs(remainingCards) do
            obj.setPosition(deckPosition)
        end
    end
end

canContinue = true
genZone = true
zones = {}
function onLoad()
  button = {click_function = 'unleash',
                                function_owner = self,
                                label = 'Unleash',
                                position = {2.7,0,0},
                                rotation = {0,90,0},
                                width = 400,
                                height = 200,
                                font_size = 70,
                                tooltip = "Shifts cards on the mat to make room for new cards drawn from the Dream Deck. Cards in the fifth zone may be removed from the mat when space is needed.(Any player suffers 2 damage and place that card on the bottom of the Dream deck)",
                                color = {r=1,b=1,g=1}

          }  -- body...
    self.createButton(button)
    positions = { -- a table containing positions to spawn scripting zones
    [1] = {-41.84, 1.96, 12.96},
    [2] = {-34.91, 1.95, 12.95},
    [3] = {-27.76, 1.94, 12.96},
    [4] = {-27.69, 1.94, 4.78},
    [5] = {-34.84, 1.95, 4.80},
    [6] = {-41.80, 1.95, 4.78}
    }
    for _,pos in pairs(positions) do
      spawnObject({
          type              = 'ScriptingTrigger', -- ScriptingTrigger is a scripting zone
          position          = pos,
          scale             = {2,2,2}, -- or whatever you want
          callback_function = function(obj)
              obj.setPosition(pos)
              zones[#zones + 1] = obj.getGUID()
              print(obj.getGUID())
          end,
          sound             = false,
          snap_to_grid      = false,
      })
    end
end

function unleash()
    if not canContinue then return end
    local bottom_position = Vector(-49.01, 2, -0.85)

    -- 阶段1：构建精确区域状态表
    local zone_states = {}
    for i = 1, 5 do
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zones[i])
        zone_states[i] = false
        if zone then
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj.type == "Card" then
                    zone_states[i] = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 阶段2：增强型单元分割算法
    local units = {}
    local current_unit = { type = zone_states[1] and "filled" or "empty", start = 1, stop = 1 }

    for i = 2, 5 do
        local current_type = zone_states[i] and "filled" or "empty"

        -- 连续同类型单元合并（仅合并filled类型）
        if current_type == current_unit.type and current_type == "filled" then
            current_unit.stop = i
        else
            table.insert(units, current_unit)
            current_unit = {
                type = current_type,
                start = i,
                stop = i
            }
        end
    end
    table.insert(units, current_unit)

    -- 阶段3：智能移动决策逻辑
    if #units == 1 and units[1].type == "filled" and units[1].stop == 5 then
        -- 全满特殊处理
        for i = 5, 1, -1 do
            local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zones[i])
            if zone then
                local target = (i ==5) and bottom_position or getObjectFromGUID(zones[i+1]).getPosition()
                moveCards(zone, target)
            end
        end
    else
        -- 严格判断第一个单元类型
        if #units > 0 and units[1].type == "filled" then
            local first_filled = units[1]
            for i = first_filled.stop, first_filled.start, -1 do
                local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zones[i])
                if zone then
                    local target = (i ==5) and bottom_position or getObjectFromGUID(zones[i+1])
                    moveCards(zone, target and target.getPosition())
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 专用卡牌移动函数
function moveCards(zone, targetPos)
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.type == "Card" then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(targetPos)
        end
    end
end

function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {saved_count = count}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    return saved_data
end

--Loads the saved data then creates the buttons
function onload(saved_data)
    generateButtonParamiters()
    --Checks if there is a saved data. If there is, it gets the saved value for 'count'
    if saved_data != '' then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        count = loaded_data.saved_count
    else
        --If there wasn't saved data, the default value is set to 10.
        count = 10
    end

    --Generates the buttons after putting the count value onto the 'display' button
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    if count >= 100 then
        b_display.font_size = 360
    else
        b_display.font_size = 500
    end
    self.createButton(b_display)
    self.createButton(b_plus)
    self.createButton(b_minus)
    self.createButton(b_plus5)
    self.createButton(b_minus5)
end

--Activates when + is hit. Adds 1 to 'count' then updates the display button.
function increase()
    count = count + 1
    updateDisplay()
end

--Activates when - is hit. Subtracts 1 from 'count' then updates the display button.
function decrease()
    --Prevents count from going below 0
    if count > 0 then
        count = count - 1
        updateDisplay()
    end
end

    count = count + 5
    updateDisplay()
end

    --Prevents count from going below 0
    if count > 4 then
        count = count - 5
    else
        count = 0
    end
    updateDisplay()
end

    local description = self.getDescription()
    if description != '' and type(tonumber(description)) == 'number' then
        self.setDescription('')
        count = tonumber(description)
        updateDisplay()
    end
end

    --If statement to resize font size if it gets too long
    if count >= 100 then

    end
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    self.editButton(b_display)

-- Universal Counter Tokens      coded by: MrStump

--Saves the count value into a table (data_to_save) then encodes it into the Tabletop save
function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {saved_count = count}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    return saved_data
end

--Loads the saved data then creates the buttons
function onload(saved_data)
    generateButtonParamiters()
    --Checks if there is a saved data. If there is, it gets the saved value for 'count'
    if saved_data != '' then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        count = loaded_data.saved_count
    else
        --If there wasn't saved data, the default value is set to 10.
        count = 10
    end

    --Generates the buttons after putting the count value onto the 'display' button
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    if count >= 100 then
        b_display.font_size = 360
    else
        b_display.font_size = 500
    end
    self.createButton(b_display)
    self.createButton(b_plus)
    self.createButton(b_minus)
    self.createButton(b_plus5)
    self.createButton(b_minus5)
end

--Activates when + is hit. Adds 1 to 'count' then updates the display button.
function increase()
    count = count + 1
    updateDisplay()
end

--Activates when - is hit. Subtracts 1 from 'count' then updates the display button.
function decrease()
    --Prevents count from going below 0
    if count > 0 then
        count = count - 1
        updateDisplay()
    end
end

--Activates when + is hit. Adds 5 to 'count' then updates the display button.
function increase5()
    count = count + 5
    updateDisplay()
end

--Activates when - is hit. Subtracts 5 from 'count' then updates the display button.
function decrease5()
    --Prevents count from going below 0
    if count > 4 then
        count = count - 5
    else
        count = 0
    end
    updateDisplay()
end

function customSet()
    local description = self.getDescription()
    if description != '' and type(tonumber(description)) == 'number' then
        self.setDescription('')
        count = tonumber(description)
        updateDisplay()
    end
end

--function that updates the display. I trigger it whenever I change 'count'
function updateDisplay()
    --If statement to resize font size if it gets too long
    if count >= 100 then
        b_display.font_size = 360
    else
        b_display.font_size = 500
    end
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    self.editButton(b_display)
end

--This is activated when onload runs. This sets all paramiters for our buttons.
--I do not have to put this all into a function, but I prefer to do it this way.
function generateButtonParamiters()
    b_display = {
        index = 0, click_function = 'customSet', function_owner = self, label = '',
        position = {0,0.1,0}, width = 600, height = 600, font_size = 500, color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,0,0}
    }
    b_plus = {
        click_function = 'increase', function_owner = self, label =  '+1',
        position = {0.75,0.1,0.26}, width = 150, height = 300, font_size = 100, color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,0,0}
    }
    b_minus = {
        click_function = 'decrease', function_owner = self, label =  '-1',
        position = {-0.75,0.1,0.26}, width = 150, height = 300, font_size = 100, color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,0,0}
    }
    b_plus5 = {
        click_function = 'increase5', function_owner = self, label =  '+5',
        position = {0.75,0.1,-0.29}, width = 150, height = 230, font_size = 100, color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,0,0}
    }
    b_minus5 = {
        click_function = 'decrease5', function_owner = self, label =  '-5',
        position = {-0.75,0.1,-0.29}, width = 150, height = 230, font_size = 100, color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,0,0}
    }
end

function searchDeck(deck, charName, pos, rot, nameOrDes, error)
    if (nameOrDes == "Des") then
      --broadcastToAll("Looking for " .. charName)
    end
    for _, card in pairs(deck.getObjects()) do
        if (nameOrDes == "Des" and card.description == charName) or (nameOrDes == "Name" and card.name == charName) or (nameOrDes == "Any") then
            return (deck.takeObject({guid = card.guid, position = pos, rotation = rot, smooth = false}))
        end
    end
    local myError = error or ""
    if (myError ~= "") then
        broadcastToAll(error, {r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
    end
end

function grabCard(color,myName,error)
  deckObj = findDecksInZone(getObjectFromGUID(myDeck))
  if deckObj == nil then
    broadcastToAll(error,{r = 1, g= 0, b = 0})
    return(nil)
  end
  if color == "White" then
    myBoard = playerBoardGUID[1]
  elseif color == "Orange" then
    myBoard = playerBoardGUID[2]
  elseif color == "Blue" then
    myBoard = playerBoardGUID[3]
  elseif color == "Purple" then
    myBoard = playerBoardGUID[4]
  end
  local boardPos = getObjectFromGUID(myBoard)
  if deckObj.tag == "Card" then
    if deckObj.getName() == myName then
      deckObj.setPositionSmooth(boardPos.getPosition() + vector(14,3,-6.4))
      deckObj.setRotationSmooth({0.00, 180.00, 0.00})
    else
      broadcastToAll(error,{r = 1, g= 0, b = 0})
    end
  else
    searchDeck(deckObj, myName, boardPos.getPosition() + vector(14,3,-6.4), {0.00, 180.00, 0.00},error)
  end
end

function takeObjectSafe(container, params, error)
    if params.guid ~= nil then
        for _, item in pairs(container.getObjects()) do
            if item.guid == params.guid then
                return container.takeObject(params)
            end
        end
    else
        return container.takeObject(params)
    end
    broadcastToAll(error,{r = 1, g= 0, b = 0})
end

function searchDeck(deck, charName,pos,rot,error)

    for _, card in pairs(deck.getObjects()) do
      if card.name == charName then
        return(deck.takeObject({guid = card.guid, position = pos, rotation = rot}))
      end
    end
    broadcastToAll(error,{r = 1, g = 0, b = 0})
end

function findDecksInZone(zone)
    local objectsInZone = zone.getObjects()
    local decksFound = {}
    for i, object in ipairs(objectsInZone) do
        if object.tag == "Deck" or object.tag == "Card" then
            return getObjectFromGUID(object.guid)
        end
    end
    if #decksFound > 0 then
        return decksFound
    else
        return nil
    end
end

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Tile
ObjectStates.Description:
Once Nemesis & Market is setup, click this to clear away scripting setup elements.

Randomizer decks stay and can still be used.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
nemesisDone = false
marketDone = false
nemScript =''
devZone = '22b514'
swapZone = '76dca9'
xaxos = false
friend = false
foe = false
playerval = 2
cleared = false
savedObjects = {}
savedTexts = {}
graveholdState = nil


function doClear()
  local textGuids = {'877410', '25e037', '5d28b0', '15c398', '99ca50', '21f5d0', '04221e'}
  savedTexts = {}
  for _, guid in ipairs(textGuids) do
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if obj ~= nil then
      savedTexts[guid] = obj.getValue()
      obj.setValue(' ')
    end
  end

  savedObjects = {}
  for i, obj in pairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if not obj.isDestroyed() then
      local pos = obj.getPosition()
      local rot = obj.getRotation()
      local shouldClear = false

      if obj.hasTag('setup') then
        shouldClear = true
      end
      if xaxos == false and obj.hasTag('xaxs') then
        shouldClear = true
      end
      if friend == false and obj.hasTag('friend') then
        shouldClear = true
      end
      if foe == false and obj.hasTag('foe') then
        shouldClear = true
      end
      if playerval == 3 and obj.hasTag('player4 mat') then
        shouldClear = true
      end
      if playerval == 2 then
        if obj.hasTag('player4 mat') then
          shouldClear = true
        end
        if obj.hasTag('player3 mat') then
          shouldClear = true
        end
      end
      if playerval == 1 then
        if obj.hasTag('player4 mat') then
          shouldClear = true
        end
        if obj.hasTag('player3 mat') then
          shouldClear = true
        end
        if obj.hasTag('player2 mat') then
          shouldClear = true
        end
      end

      if shouldClear then
        local guid = obj.getGUID()
        savedObjects[guid] = {
          posX = pos.x, posY = pos.y, posZ = pos.z,
          rotX = rot.x, rotY = rot.y, rotZ = rot.z,
          locked = obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.setPosition({pos.x, pos.y - 20, pos.z})
        if obj.getName() == 'Randomizer Setup Board' then
          local curPos = obj.getPosition()
          obj.setPosition({curPos.x, curPos.y, curPos.z + 80})
        end
        obj.setLock(true)
      end
    end
  end

  if xaxos == true then
    local gravehold = getObjectFromGUID('875d2d')
    if gravehold ~= nil then
      graveholdState = gravehold.getStateId()
      gravehold.setState(2)
    end
  end
end

function doRestore()
  for guid, text in pairs(savedTexts) do
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if obj ~= nil then
      obj.setValue(text or ' ')
    end
  end

  for guid, data in pairs(savedObjects) do
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if obj ~= nil and not obj.isDestroyed() then
      obj.setLock(data.locked == true)
      obj.setPosition({data.posX, data.posY, data.posZ})
      obj.setRotation({data.rotX, data.rotY, data.rotZ})
    end
  end

  if graveholdState ~= nil then
    local gravehold = getObjectFromGUID('875d2d')
    if gravehold ~= nil then
      gravehold.setState(graveholdState)
    end
    graveholdState = nil
  end

  savedObjects = {}
  savedTexts = {}
end


function lock()
  if not cleared then
    if self.getGMNotes() ~= '1' then
      if (nemesisDone == false and marketDone == false) then
        broadcastToAll('Setup Nemesis and Lock Market first!', {r=1,b=0.1,g=0.1})
        return
      elseif nemesisDone == true and marketDone == false then
        broadcastToAll('Lock Market first!', {r=1,b=0.1,g=0.1})
        return
      elseif
        nemesisDone == false and marketDone == true then
        broadcastToAll('Setup Nemesis first!', {r=1,b=0.1,g=0.1})
        return
      end
    end
    doClear()
    cleared = true
    self.editButton({
      index = 0,
      label = 'Restore Setup',
      tooltip = 'Restore all cleared setup elements to their original positions.'
    })
  else
    doRestore()
    cleared = false
    self.editButton({
      index = 0,
      label = 'Clear Setup',
      tooltip = 'Once Nemesis & Market is setup, click this to clear away scripting setup elements.\nRandomizer decks stay and can still be used.'
    })
  end
end



function onSave()
  local tableToSave = {
    ['nemesisDone'] = nemesisDone,
    ['marketDone'] = marketDone,
    ['playerval'] = playerval,
    ['xaxos'] = xaxos,
    ['friend'] = friend,
    ['foe'] = foe,
    ['cleared'] = cleared,
    ['savedObjects'] = savedObjects,
    ['savedTexts'] = savedTexts,
    ['graveholdState'] = graveholdState
  }
  return JSON.encode(tableToSave)
end

function onload(saved_data)
  if saved_data ~= nil then
    local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
    if loaded_data ~= nil then
      nemesisDone = loaded_data['nemesisDone'] or self.getVar('nemesisDone') or false
      marketDone = loaded_data['marketDone'] or self.getVar('marketDone') or false
      playerval = loaded_data['playerval'] or self.getVar('playerval') or 2
      xaxos = loaded_data['xaxos'] or self.getVar('xaxos') or false
      friend = loaded_data['friend'] or self.getVar('friend') or false
      foe = loaded_data['foe'] or self.getVar('foe') or false
      cleared = loaded_data['cleared'] or false
      savedObjects = loaded_data['savedObjects'] or {}
      savedTexts = loaded_data['savedTexts'] or {}
      graveholdState = loaded_data['graveholdState']
    end
  end

  local labelText = 'Clear Setup'
  local tooltipText = 'Once Nemesis & Market is setup, click this to clear away scripting setup elements.\nRandomizer decks stay and can still be used.'
  if cleared then
    labelText = 'Restore Setup'
    tooltipText = 'Restore all cleared setup elements to their original positions.'
  end

  local param = {
  click_function = "lock",
  function_owner = self,
  label = labelText,
  position = {0, 0.5, 0},
  rotation = {0, 0, 0},
  width = 800,
  height = 300,
  color = {r = 0, g = 1, b = 1},
  font_size = 110,
  tooltip = tooltipText
  }

  self.createButton(param)

end
